misconceptions.name: Conflation of Distance and Displacement
misconceptions.description: Treats displacement as scalar distance, ignoring direction in closed or reverse paths.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Calculates non-zero average velocity for round-trips where displacement is zero.

misconceptions.name: Aristotelian Impetus Fallacy
misconceptions.description: Believes a continuous net force is necessary to sustain constant velocity.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Asserts F_net > 0 when acceleration a = 0 on frictionless surfaces.

misconceptions.name: Mass-Dependent Gravitational Acceleration
misconceptions.description: Believes heavier objects accelerate faster during free fall in vacuum.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Predicts a heavier mass reaches the ground first when air resistance is neglected.

misconceptions.name: Cartesian Sign Inversion for Focal Length
misconceptions.description: Assigns positive sign to concave mirror focal length or reverses sign convention.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Substitutes f = +15 cm instead of f = -15 cm for concave mirror.

misconceptions.name: Mirror vs. Lens Formula Swap
misconceptions.description: Applies lens formula (1/v - 1/u = 1/f) to mirror problems or vice versa.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Subtracts 1/u instead of adding 1/u in spherical mirror calculations.

misconceptions.name: Universal Inversion Assumption for Concave Mirrors
misconceptions.description: Assumes concave mirrors can only produce real, inverted images regardless of object position.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Claims image is real and inverted when object is between Pole and Focus.

misconceptions.name: Current Attenuation Fallacy
misconceptions.description: Believes electric current is consumed as it passes through series resistors.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: States current after R1 is smaller than current before R1 in series.

misconceptions.name: Parallel Equal Current Assumption
misconceptions.description: Assumes current divides equally across parallel branches regardless of resistance values.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Divides total current equally when branch resistances are unequal.

misconceptions.name: Parallel Resistance Reciprocal Inversion Omission
misconceptions.description: Calculates 1/R_p = 1/R1 + 1/R2 but forgets to take reciprocal, reporting decimal sum as R_p.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Reports R_p as 0.25 ohms instead of 4 ohms.

misconceptions.name: Zero-Velocity Implies Zero-Acceleration at Apex
misconceptions.description: Assumes acceleration is zero at maximum projectile height because instantaneous vertical velocity is zero.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Claims a = 0 m/s^2 at the top of projectile flight.

concepts.concept_name: Newton's Laws & Normal Force on Incline

misconceptions.name: Normal Force Universal mg Equivalence
misconceptions.description: Equates normal reaction force N universally to mg, neglecting incline angle theta.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Uses N = mg on inclined surfaces instead of N = mg*cos(theta).

misconceptions.name: Zero Potential Implies Zero Electric Field
misconceptions.description: Conflates scalar electric potential V with vector field E, assuming V=0 entails E=0.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Claims electric field is zero at the midpoint between opposite charges of an electric dipole.

misconceptions.name: Lenz's Law Opposes Field Rather Than Flux Change
misconceptions.description: Believes induced magnetic field always opposes external field direction, rather than opposing the change in flux.
misconceptions.trigger_pattern: Predicts opposing induced B-field even when external field is collapsing/decreasing.

baseline_classes.name: Correct Solution
baseline_classes.description: Accurate physical reasoning, valid substitutions, correct result.

baseline_classes.name: Arithmetic Calculation Slip
baseline_classes.description: Correct physics and formula, but computation slip.

baseline_classes.name: Unit Conversion Error
baseline_classes.description: Correct physical concepts, but omitted or incorrect unit conversion.

baseline_classes.name: Insufficient Working / Guess
baseline_classes.description: Bare answer entered without steps or contradictory scribbles; system abstains.
